name: theygrow-native-shell
description: Dev/CI-only Capacitor Android shell for the theygrow PWA (L1-P1). Not part of either delivery channel's web assets: the APK's web root is assembled by tools/stage-webdir.js from app/Dockerfile's COPY list, and nothing in node_modules/ is ever copied into it. No bundler, no transpiler — the web path stays buildless in both channels.
